title: Amazing 3BR/2BA Poolside @ Sandy Beach

images.caption: Fisheye view of pool and building

description: This beautiful 3 BR, 2 bath condo is right next to the pool, 1 short block from Sandy Beach, and near the best restaurants, bars, surfing, and family-friendly activities in Puntas. You’ll love my place because of the ideal location and amenities. The pool is a great spot to cool off, let kids play, or have an evening drink. The condo has everything you need. Come enjoy!The spaceThe condo is in a 6 unit development and was completed in 2011. The condo's front balcony brings you into a spacious open concept living room, dining area, and kitchen. You'll find places to relax, watch TV, use the high speed internet, or cook in a fully stocked kitchen. The three bedrooms comfortably sleep seven (a queen bed in the Master, a queen bed in the second bedroom, and a double bed in the third bedroom with an additional twin bunk above). There are two full bathrooms, a washer/dryer, and all rooms have large powerful ACs (although with ocean breezes and ceiling fans you hardly ever need them). There is excellent WIFI coverage and the kitchen is fully equipped with utensils, cookware, and condiments.Also included are beach chairs, masks, snorkels, fins, boogie boards, frisbee, and a cooler. This is a dream rental for families (pack and play, high chair, and stroller in the condo), surfers, SCUBA divers, deep sea fishers, zip line/eco tourist enthusiasts, horseback riders, and golfers. We are within a few minute drive to over a dozen world class surfing breaks, an amazing under water preserve that offers world class snorkeling, and walking distance to Sandy Beach and Pools Beach. Spectacular waterfalls are a 45 minute drive. No need to bring your boards if you don’t want to. For an additional fee you have access to the home’s quiver which includes; 9’0 Robert August high-end performance long board (surfteck); 9'1' McTavish Fireball (fiberglass noserider); 9’0 Rusty (gun shaped, great in the big stuff, but also a very floaty fiberglass wave catcher); a 6’4” Eerie Peeples retro, quad, noserider fish; and a 6’1” Firewire short board; roof racks, and wax are also included. These are all high-end personal boards and only available to my guests who prefer not to lug their boards and pay the price of flying. Other area activities include SCUBA, snorkeling, deep sea fishing, golf, sailing, water falls, para-sailing, kite-sailing, whale watching, zip-line tours, bio-luminescence bays, horse back riding, casino, tennis, shelling, hiking, jet skiing, great food, and just hanging out. While the house comfortably sleeps 7 in beds, we will entertain larger groups at the owner's discretion. An extra per person fee will be applied after 6 guests. There is a pull out couch/futon in the living room and an extra twin/single mattress that can be used on the floor.Guest accessThe condo is in a gated access property with swimming pool, gazebo area with bathrooms, and an outdoor shower.Other things to noteThe property has a powerful new generator that runs everything in case of a power outage in the area.
amenities: Shared outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, pool toys

title: Double King Suite with a View
description: Escape to the ocean breeze in this spacious suite, perfect for families or groups of friends. The suite features 2 comfortable king beds, coffee machine, small fridge, Wi-Fi, A/C, and a hot water shower. The suite is located on the 3rd floor, accessible by stairs only and has a partial ocean view. The property is a self-catering guesthouse and additional information is available on-site. Please note that this room is non-smoking and not pet-friendly.The spaceHi! Welcome to Paradise! Please be aware that this unit is not standalone property. Common areas are shared with other guests staying in other rooms. All rooms have private entrances and bathrooms. Please contact us with any questions or concerns. Property includes 2 pools, 3 buildings, free parking spaces, and Wi-Fi. We have no lifeguards on duty in pool areas. We have pet-friendly (pet fee*) rooms, you may see pets in common areas. We also have closed-circuit security cameras recording 24/7 in common areas for your safety. There are no cameras or audio recordings inside any private space of the unit. We are located in a rural area with fully paved roads, close to the beach, restaurants and other places of interest in a hillside surrounded by many trees and nature. It would be best to have a car rental to enjoy this beautiful town. If you have any questions about your room and/or reservation, please contact us through Airbnb inbox. We have staff on site during daytime hours in case you need assistance. Access to room will be sent through inbox around 3-4pm or as soon as the room is ready for use. Any changes must be processed at least 24 hours before arrival date. We have a non-visitor policy. Only registered guests are allowed to enter room or use facilities. Rooms have a maximum of guests. Please read room description before arrival day. Changes upon arrival are not possible most of the time because we have limited spaces. We check and document rooms before giving access. Expect some natural tear and wear of room. A/C’s must be kept on during your stay to prevent excessive moisture inside room. Cristal windows let in light but cannot be open to prevent damage to A/C and unwanted bugs inside room.Guest accessWelcome! You can check in any time as soon as you receive access to the room. The room has a lockbox with the key next to its door. Information is sent through Airbnb inbox. Nothing to sign at reception, you can go straight into the room when you arrive. We are posted in internet as “Serenity Rincon Guesthouse” If you have any questions someone will be available until 8pm every day of the week. We have free parking in open areas around the property. Please do not block entrance or other car. Our check out time is 11:30am. Please read “cancelation policies” and “Additional Rules” as reservation cannot be changed upon arrival. We are on site during daytime hours in case you need assistance. The room is non-smoking (fee*). Not all rooms are pet friendly (fee*) Happy Trails!Other things to noteInternet may fail during your stay do to power outages and/or repairs being done by the island's electric company. We have a power generator and water tanks that feed all rooms.

title: Seaside Serenity, Stunning Rooftop Retreat
description: Wake up to breathtaking ocean views and the sound of waves at this stunning 4BR coastal escape. Just steps from the beach, this stylish retreat blends laid-back island vibes with modern luxury. Sip coffee above the ocean, unwind in the rooftop lounge, and watch the sun disappear over the water. Every room is designed for comfort, making this the perfect Rincón getaway. Come for the views. Stay for the sunsets. Stairs required.The spaceCasa Riptides Upper Level Wake up to the ocean, spend your days at the beach, and watch unforgettable sunsets from your own rooftop.Welcome to Casa Riptides Upper Level, a stunning oceanfront retreat in Stella, Rincón, created for families and groups who want to experience the very best of Puerto Rico without giving up comfort or luxury.With 4 beautifully appointed bedrooms, 3 modern bathrooms, panoramic ocean views, and spacious indoor and outdoor living areas, there is room to spread out, relax, and truly enjoy your time together.Start your morning with coffee on the glass-railed balcony as you watch the waves, then grab everything you need from your fully stocked private beach lockers and head down for a day in the sand. When you’re ready to come back, rinse off and fire up the chic outdoor kitchen for an easy al fresco dinner while the sun sets over the water.There are two expansive lounges for relaxing, gathering, or watching a movie, plus a beautiful rooftop terrace that becomes the perfect spot for sunset cocktails and late nights under the stars.Inside, every detail is designed to make your stay easy and comfortable, with air conditioning, ceiling fans, high-speed WiFi, modern finishes, and plenty of space for everyone. And with a 22KW Generac generator, you can enjoy peace of mind throughout your stay.Whether you're planning a family vacation, a beach getaway with friends, or simply looking for a place where you can slow down and enjoy island life, Casa Riptides Upper Level puts you right where you want to be with the ocean as your backyard.Come for the oceanfront location. Stay for the sunsets, rooftop nights, and memories you’ll be talking about long after you leave.Other things to noteWelcome to Casa Riptides! Experience a charming 2-unit ocean-adjacent vacation rental with exclusive access to the top two floors. Enjoy the convenience of driveway parking, but please note that stairs are required to reach this unit. The ground floor hosts a separate 2-bedroom apartment, ensuring privacy for all guests.Embrace the island life, which may come with occasional service interruptions. While we've equipped the property with a 22KW Generac generator for backup, please be aware that Wi-Fi, electricity, or water may occasionally be affected. Note that no refunds or compensation will be provided for outages.Although there’s no direct beach access, Playa Corcega is just a short walk away, only six houses dow; allowing you to easily enjoy the beautiful sand and surf.

description: Nestled in the safest community in Rincon, our villa is just steps from your own private beach where you can swim and take in some of the most amazing sunsets! Grocery shopping, restaurants and stores are a quick ride into town where you will also find a local art walk on Thursday nights and town market on Sundays.The spaceRincon is the sweetest place in the entire Caribbean! Take in the sunsets from our large and comfortably furnished 3rd floor patio, or spend it down on the beach next to the waves. This is our home away from home and we make sure to keep it cozy, clean and well stocked for all your family or small group's needs. Fits groups of 6-8 comfortably.Guest accessYou will have full access to the house, including outside shed containing beach chairs and a beach umbrella. There is a gas grill on the garden patio are as well as a well equipped cooking setup in the kitchen. Fresh bed linens, towels and beach towels for your group. Guests can use the pool, gym, tennis courts and basketball courts. There are no fees for use of the facilities.If you have any questions or concerns as to how our villa will suit your family's needs just message us! We have a 100% response rate and would love to help you determine if our villa is the perfect fit!Other things to noteRemember that these beaches and areas are full of surfers! Being a surfing community of beaches one must be aware of the sometime strong currents as there is no lifeguard on duty at the private beaches. During these times, if traveling with small children, when you approach the beach hang a left and there is small natural pool at the shore line. Water in this area is protected by reef and the current is mostly abated in the pool making it is safer for less experienced swimmers or small children.
